primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants With a Treatment-Emergent AEs (TEAE) or a Serious AE
primaryOutcomes.description: An AE is any adverse experience in a participant administered a study drug, whether or not it is considered drug related, that occurred during study participation. This would include any side effect, injury, toxicity, sensitivity reaction, intercurrent illness, or sudden death. Conditions that started before study entry were reported as an AE if the frequency, intensity, or character of the condition worsened during the study. A TEAE was defined as any AE that newly appeared, increased in frequency, or worsened in severity following initiation of study drug. A serious AE (SAE) was defined as any AE that resulted in death, is life-threatening, required inpatient hospitalization or prolongation of existing hospitalization, resulted in disability/permanent damage, was a congenital anomaly/birth defect, or was an important medical event. A summary of SAEs and all nonserious AEs ("Other"), regardless of causality, is located in the Reported "Adverse Events" section.

technology.title: 分类采用两条轴：编码什么，以及如何递送
technology.detail: 个体化新抗原、共享肿瘤抗原、病毒抗原、免疫调节蛋白和抗体表达是载荷轴；LNP、RNA-LPX、局部给药、ex vivo DC是递送轴。saRNA/circRNA属于RNA结构轴，不能与载荷类别相互替代。
technology.implication: BD资料首先写清载荷、剂型、给药途径、作用细胞和临床阶段，防止把RNA项目数量误当疫苗数量。

technology.title: 抗原选择：突变存在不代表能产生有效T细胞反应
technology.detail: 研究设计需同时审查肿瘤纯度、正常对照、克隆性、RNA表达、HLA分型、抗原加工呈递及异质性。TCR扩增是机制证据；免疫反应、肿瘤缩小与生存终点必须分开。
technology.implication: 可合作验证样本前处理、WES/RNA-seq/HLA检测与算法可追溯性；预测算法的分数本身不能作为临床有效性结论。

technology.title: 制造质控：患者级批次仍需要可比性与效力放行
technology.detail: 建议的CMC工作包包括序列身份、RNA完整性、加帽/poly(A)、双链RNA及残留杂质、粒径/PDI、包封率、效力、无菌/内毒素、稳定性。每项方法必须按具体产品开发确认，不能套用统一合格线。
technology.implication: 检测企业可切入方法开发、转移和桥接验证；药物放行与临床样本检测为不同资质边界。EMA现有2025草案正式范围是传染病疫苗，原则借鉴不等于肿瘤药物适用法规。

technology.title: TAT与身份链：制造成功率之外还缺哪些数据
technology.detail: 从筛查、合格组织、序列可用、成功设计、批次放行到首次给药逐层记录损耗。制造成功率的分母可能仅为随机分配患者，不能代表所有筛查患者均能及时治疗。
technology.implication: 要求合作方给出患者级交付时间分布、排除原因、等待期间复发、重制率和成本；在没有公开数据前不作商业毛利预测。

technology.title: MRD：预后富集与疗效预测是两个问题
technology.detail: ctDNA阳性可富集高复发风险，但是否预测某种疫苗的治疗获益需要随机交互作用或预设验证。CRC的阴性和终止结果不支持以“MRD阳性”直接作为疫苗有效的论据。
technology.implication: 优先做研究性纵向采样、检测性能与终点桥接；不要包装为已批准的伴随诊断，也不要以ctDNA清除替代生存获益。

technology.title: 递送前沿：靶向与局部表达必须共同评价暴露和毒性
technology.detail: 延长RNA表达、调节先天免疫或提高淋巴器官摄取均可能改善药效，也可能增加炎症、非靶组织表达与重复给药风险。临床前肿瘤抑制不能直接外推患者疗效。
technology.implication: 优先谈生物分布、暴露反应、免疫因子与重复给药检测；in vivo CAR、circRNA、saRNA分别建立证据层级。

coverageNotes.boundary: core: individualized neoantigen mRNA cancer vaccine
coverageNotes.setting: Resected pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma; randomized adjuvant vaccine + atezolizumab + mFOLFIRINOX versus mFOLFIRINOX.
coverageNotes.delivery: Intravenous RNA-lipoplex; distinguish from intramuscular LNP products.
coverageNotes.statusNote: API: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, updated 2026-09-09; Phase 2; estimated enrollment 260, not an efficacy analysis population.

coverageNotes.boundary: core: shared tumor-associated antigen mRNA vaccine; historical program
coverageNotes.payload: Six NSCLC-associated antigens: MUC1, survivin, NY-ESO-1, 5T4, MAGE-C2, MAGE-C1.
coverageNotes.delivery: RNActive platform; intradermal administration. NCT03164772 includes PharmaJet Tropis device. Do not normalize as LNP.
coverageNotes.statusNote: NCT03164772 COMPLETED; NCT01915524 TERMINATED for slow recruitment in stratum 3. Trial completion does not establish a currently active commercial development program.

coverageNotes.boundary: adjacent: ex vivo CAR-T plus an RNA vaccine that amplifies CAR-T; not in vivo CAR generation and not vaccine monotherapy
coverageNotes.delivery: CLDN6 CAR-T intravenous infusion; CLDN6-encoding RNA-LPX intravenous injections.
coverageNotes.statusNote: API ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING (2026-06-18). BioNTech Q3 2026 states enrollment complete, CARVac treatment/follow-up ongoing and no further clinical development currently planned. Both facts must remain visible.

coverageNotes.boundary: core RNA-containing heterologous regimen: personalized neoantigen adenoviral prime plus saRNA boost; separate from conventional mRNA-only vaccines
coverageNotes.delivery: GRT-C901: replication-defective chimpanzee adenovirus 68; GRT-R902: self-amplifying RNA encapsulated in LNP. Intramuscular prime/boost; not two names for the same product.
coverageNotes.statusNote: API: NCT05141721 ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, last updated 2025-05-16; NCT03639714 COMPLETED; NCT05456165 WITHDRAWN, actual enrollment 0, due to reprioritization. Gritstone entered Chapter 11 in 2024 and a court sale was approved; no unverified inference that every trial is terminated or that the successor is currently conducting development.
coverageNotes.phaseCaution: NCT05141721 records PHASE2 and PHASE3 and estimated enrollment 700. This planned registration description is not evidence that Phase 3 began or 700 participants were treated.

coverageNotes.boundary: core: whole-tumor RNA approach; not selected-mutation neoantigen mRNA vaccine
coverageNotes.payload: Autologous total tumor mRNA plus pp65 full-length LAMP mRNA.
coverageNotes.delivery: DOTAP liposomes; intravenous RNA-loaded lipid particles. Adult newly diagnosed GBM and pediatric high-grade glioma strata must be kept distinct.
coverageNotes.statusNote: API RECRUITING, updated 2026-10-30; Phase 1; estimated enrollment 28. Primary purpose includes manufacturing feasibility, safety and MTD, not a confirmed survival benefit.

coverageNotes.boundary: core: shared ovarian tumor-associated antigen mRNA vaccine; historical terminated study
coverageNotes.delivery: Three ovarian-cancer TAA RNA-LPX products; intravenous administration with neoadjuvant/adjuvant chemotherapy.
coverageNotes.statusNote: API TERMINATED for failure to reach the target evaluable population despite extended recruitment; actual enrollment 8. BioNTech 2023 20-F says 10 recruited, 8 dosed, follow-up completed June 2023 and no follow-up studies planned. Keep recruited/dosed/registry-enrolled counts separate.

coverageNotes.boundary: core: shared mutant-KRAS neoantigen mRNA vaccine; do not merge its two distinct protocols
coverageNotes.delivery: Intramuscular mRNA vaccination. Lipid formulation details not inferred from platform branding.
coverageNotes.statusNote: API: both RECRUITING. NCT06577532 EARLY_PHASE1 (56 estimated, toripalimab); NCT07455617 PHASE1 (101 estimated, sintilimab). Sponsor's 2025 dual IND announcement is authorization to test, not marketing approval or clinical efficacy.

coverageNotes.boundary: core: shared/multi-antigen mRNA vaccine; separate from personalized ZY008
coverageNotes.delivery: LNP using proprietary cationic lipid YK-009; intramuscular injection per registry.
coverageNotes.statusNote: API RECRUITING, updated 2026-10-13; Phase 1; 76 estimated. HLA-A*11:01 plus target-antigen selection restricts eligibility; not an unrestricted pan-cancer vaccine. Primary endpoints are DLT/TEAE/SAE.

coverageNotes.boundary: adjacent clinical indication: HPV16-positive cervical HSIL (precancer); HPV-associated solid-tumor development remains exploratory in cited announcement
coverageNotes.delivery: mRNA encoding HPV16 E6/E7; proprietary LNP per 2024 company disclosure.
coverageNotes.statusNote: Exact-name ClinicalTrials.gov API search returned 0, not proof of no trials. Luye 2026-08-20 announced a Chinese Phase 2 HSIL study would start; do not convert 'would start' into recruiting or completed Phase 2. Company reports Phase 1 HPV clearance near 90%, but supplies no public denominator/CI in that announcement; do not chart as confirmed tumor response or compare with ORR.

coverageNotes.boundary: core: personalized mRNA vaccine in advanced solid tumors; separately registered outside ClinicalTrials.gov
coverageNotes.statusNote: ChiCTR original-page search index identifies a prospective registration dated 2026-01-26 and single-arm design. Direct fetch returned HTTP 405. No NCT ID, sponsor, delivery formulation, recruiting status, enrollment or results are invented.
